name: media-buyer-toolkit
description: Paid media operations toolkit — one stateless stdio MCP server (social-media-ads-mcp, en shared/) fronting Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google Ads, YouTube and Spotify behind one normalized operation contract: accounts, campaigns, ad groups, creatives, audiences, insights, async reports. Drafts-first by construction, guardrails evaluated before any network call, capability matrix declared per network, and one unified insights row schema where null and zero are distinct.
